description: Unit test class for BestFitBalancer algorithm, testing resource distribution and ordering invariance.

classes.name: BestFitBalancerTests
classes.description: Contains multiple unit tests for the BestFitBalancer resource distribution algorithm.

methods.name: IdealCaseMoreResourcesThanBucketsTest
methods.description: Tests resource distribution when resources exceed buckets.

methods.name: IdealCaseMoreResourcesThanBuckets2Test
methods.description: Tests resource distribution with a different resource and bucket count.

methods.name: IdealCaseLessResourcesThanBucketsTest
methods.description: Tests resource distribution when resources are fewer than buckets.

methods.name: IdealCaseLessResourcesThanBuckets2Test
methods.description: Another variation of resource distribution with fewer resources than buckets.

methods.name: IdealCaseResourcesMatchBucketsTest
methods.description: Tests resource distribution when resources equal buckets.

methods.name: IdealCaseResourcesDevisibleByBucketsTest
methods.description: Tests resource distribution when resources are divisible evenly by buckets.

methods.name: IdealCaseRangedTest
methods.description: Range-based testing for various resource and bucket counts.

methods.name: HalfBucketsActiveTest
methods.description: Tests distribution with only half of the buckets active.

methods.name: OrderIrrelevantTest
methods.description: Verifies that resource distribution is consistent regardless of input order.

methods.name: ValidateBalance
methods.description: Helper method to validate the distribution balance against the ideal.
